---
title: "panelA"
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic) # Our all-in-one package
library(skimr) # Looking at data
library(janitor) # Clean the data
library(naniar) # Handle missing data
library(visdat) # Visualise missing data
library(tinytable) # Printing Static Tables for our data
library(DT) # Interactive Tables for our data
library(crosstable) # Multiple variable summaries
```

```{r}
glimpse(panelAdata)

```

```{r}
inspect(panelAdata)
```

```{r}
skim(panelA_mod)
```

```{r}
datatable(panelAdata) 
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> ggplot(aes(smok)) + geom_bar (color="blue", fill=rgb(0.1,0.4,0.5,0.7) )
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_point(sys ~ dia, color = ~ smok)
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_point(sys ~ dia, color = ~ age)
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_histogram(~ hdl, fill = ~ smok, position = "dodge", bins=25) |> gf_facet_wrap(~ factor(sex))
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_histogram(~ ldl, fill = ~ smok, position = "dodge", bins=25) |> gf_facet_wrap(~ factor(sex))

```

```{r}
#Do smokers and non-smokers in this group have different HDL and LDL levels, for men and women?
panelAdata |>
  pivot_longer(c(hdl, ldl), names_to = "cholesterol", values_to = "level") |>
  gf_histogram(~ level, fill = ~ smok, alpha = 0.5) |>
  gf_facet_grid(cholesterol ~ factor(sex))
#how much smoking matters - NEGATIVE
```

```{r}
#alcohol consumption and smoking has a correlation with cholestrol levels in blood?
panelAdata |> gf_histogram(choles~ alco, color = ~ smok, position = "dodge", bins=25) #|> gf_facet_wrap(~ factor(sex))
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_point(age ~ Uric, color = ~ sex)
```

```{r}
panelAdata |>
  pivot_longer(c(choles, trig), names_to = "cholesterol", values_to = "level") |>
  gf_histogram(~ level, fill = ~ smok, alpha = 0.5) |>
  gf_facet_grid(cholesterol ~ factor(sex))
```

```{r}
panelAdata |> gf_histogram(choles~ trig, color = ~ smok, position = "dodge", bins=25) |> gf_facet_wrap(~ factor(sex))

```

```{r}
panelA_mod <- panelAdata |> mutate(sex = as.factor(sex), smok = as.factor(smok))
```

```{r}
glimpse(panelA_mod)
```

```{r}
panelA_mod |> gf_point(hdl ~ alco) |> gf_smooth(method = "lm")
```
